subject.title: [Bug]: Subagent run completion is delivered to chat user as raw worker output instead of parent/main summary

question: For direct subagent completions without an explicit messaging-tool send, should OpenClaw suppress external delivery entirely, or add a typed sanitized/public parent-reply signal that can be delivered safely?
rationale: The observed fallback leaks internal child output, but a narrow suppression changes no-reply behavior and auto-promoting parent final text can leak the same private content through another field.

options.title: Add an explicit public completion signal
options.body: Introduce a typed parent-owned public-delivery result and send only that to the channel, keeping child completion text internal.

options.title: Fail closed for message-tool-only delivery
options.body: Remove or gate the direct child-text fallback so absent an explicit message-tool send there is no external completion message.

options.title: Retain the child fallback
options.body: Keep current empty-parent resilience, accepting that internal child text can reach the requester’s direct channel.

recommendation.title: Add an explicit public completion signal
recommendation.body: Introduce a typed parent-owned public-delivery result and send only that to the channel, keeping child completion text internal.

likelyOwner.reason: Their open work covers the adjacent announce lifecycle and they are the strongest available routing candidate from the supplied feature context.
